text: ポケモンを　たくさん　とると　なまえを　つけて　あげるのに　くろう　しちゃう　でしょ！

structure.jp: ポケモンを　たくさん　とると
structure.en: when you catch lots of Pokémon

structure.jp: なまえを　つけて　あげるのに
くろう　しちゃう　でしょ！
structure.en: you end up having a hard time, don't you!

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'when' or 'whenever' this happens, the next thing follows naturally. たくさん とると = 'when you catch lots'.

patterns.name: 〜のに (purpose)
patterns.span: つけて　あげるのに
patterns.explanation: Here の turns 'giving names' into a thing and に says what the trouble is for; it is not the のに that means 'even though'. つけて あげるのに = 'in order to give them names'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃう is the casual short form of てしまう, which says something ends up happening, often when you would rather it did not. くろう しちゃう = 'you end up struggling'.
